items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a cocontinuous functor induces a cocontinuous functor between the localized sites, giving a commutative diagram of topoi (statement lines 6747-6771). The proof is a complete argument: the commutativity of the diagram of site functors is clear and the diagram of topoi follows once the induced functor is shown to be cocontinuous (proof lines 6774-6776); and cocontinuity is verified by taking a covering in the localized target, using cocontinuity of the original functor to produce a covering of the source whose images refine it, and viewing its members as objects over the localizing object (proof lines 6779-6792). The non-formal content is the refinement and the reinterpretation of the covering in the localized site. The claim is H2: a written-out verification with each input named.
